name: XiotBox OpenClaw Channel
description: XiotBox channel plugin for OpenClaw with remote chat delivery, optional device-control tools, and bridge-mode support.

toolMetadata.name: XiotBox Local Control
toolMetadata.description: Optional local-control HTTP tool for trusted XiotBox device-control actions.

toolMetadata.name: XiotBox Control
toolMetadata.description: Optional XiotBox control-plan tool for trusted device-control workflows.

xiotbox.label: XiotBox
xiotbox.description: Connects OpenClaw to XiotBox Gateway via WSS for remote chat, streaming, E2E messages, and optional device-control tools.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the XiotBox channel plugin.

name.description: Optional display name override for this channel instance.

GATEWAY_WSS_URL.description: XiotBox Gateway WebSocket Secure endpoint used for remote channel connectivity.

DEVICE_ID.description: XiotBox device identity used by the remote channel session.

DEVICE_TOKEN.description: Secret device token paired with DEVICE_ID.

USE_QUERY_AUTH.description: Use query-string authentication when required by the target gateway.

OUTBOX_MAX.description: Maximum number of queued outbound messages kept before trimming.

OUTBOX_TTL_MS.description: Time-to-live for queued outbound messages in milliseconds.

COMMAND_CACHE_TTL_MS.description: Retention window for command de-duplication cache entries in milliseconds.

COMMAND_CACHE_MAX.description: Maximum number of cached command entries kept for de-duplication.

STREAMING.description: Enable reply streaming when the runtime and target route support it.

STREAM_THROTTLE_MS.description: Throttle interval for streaming updates in milliseconds.

PROGRESS_UPDATES.description: Emit lightweight progress events alongside the main reply path.

PROGRESS_THROTTLE_MS.description: Throttle interval for progress events in milliseconds.

PROGRESS_MAX_UPDATES.description: Upper bound for progress event count per request.

API_BASE_URL.description: HTTP API base URL used for XiotBox API operations.

E2E_KEY_PATH.description: Optional path to the end-to-end encryption key material.

E2E_ROTATE.description: Optional E2E rotation policy or override value.

IDENTITY_KEY_PATH.description: Optional path to the local identity key material.

TRUST_PATH.description: Optional path to the trust store used for peer pinning or identity trust.

ALLOW_NEW_CLIENT_IDENTITIES.description: Allow new client identities to be enrolled automatically when enabled.

SCOPES.description: Allowed XiotBox scopes for this runtime, such as chat or control.

CONTROL_ACTIONS.description: Optional allowlist of local control actions exposed by the plugin tools.

AGENT_ID.description: OpenClaw agent id used when resolving session metadata. Defaults to main.

SESSION_AGENT_ID.description: Optional session metadata agent id override. Takes precedence over AGENT_ID.

SESSION_AGENT_MAP.description: Optional map from XiotBox thread/role id to OpenClaw agent id. Use '*' or 'default' as fallback.

THREAD_AGENT_MAP.description: Deprecated alias of SESSION_AGENT_MAP, kept for compatibility.

LOCAL_CONTROL_BASE_URL.description: Base URL of the XiotBox local-control service used by optional control tools.

LOCAL_CONTROL_TOKEN.description: Optional token required by the local-control endpoint.

LOCAL_CONTROL_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for local-control HTTP calls in milliseconds.
